newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KSE orders trading halt in Anam Ind.
newsitem.headline: KSE orders trading halt in Anam Ind.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said it would suspend trading in the shares of Anam Industrial Co for Monday's morning session.
An exchange statement said the decision was made after the company set a 15-for-100 bonus issue for January 1997 as part of a plan to raise its paid-in capital to 134.4 billion won.
Under the South Korean securities regulations, the exchange is subject to order the trading suspension when a company announces a bonus issue of more than 10 percent.
Trading of Anam shares will resume from Monday's afternoon session. Anam shares closed at 15,000 won on Saturday.
